# The Actually-Free Job Training Directory

> Zero-dollar upskilling: university courses in audit mode, library learning platforms, free certificates, state workforce programs, and CEU samplers for health workers.

A plain-English directory of upskilling that costs zero dollars: university courses in audit mode, learning platforms unlocked by a library card, certificates that are genuinely free (Google and cloud basics included), US state and federal workforce programs, and CEU samplers for licensed health workers.

**5 categories, 28 offers.** Last verified: 2026-11-08.

## How to read every entry

- Every offer listed here costs $0.00 to use in the way described. If an offer later grows a paywall, it gets flagged and fixed or removed.
- Nobody in this directory pays us. There are no affiliate links, no referral codes, and no tracking parameters on any URL.
- Each entry says exactly what "free" means for that offer: free everywhere, free with a library card, free course content but paid paper, or a government check that pays tuition for you.
- Certificates and CEUs matter or they don't exist here: if an entry mentions a paper trail, the entry tells you whether that paper is free.

## Quick-start pointers

- **"I just want college-level courses, free."** Start with [university audit mode](pages/audit-courses.md).
- **"I have a library card and never use it."** See what it already pays for: [library platforms](pages/library-platforms.md).
- **"I want something to show a recruiter."** Go for the free certificates: [Google, cloud basics & more](pages/free-certificates.md).
- **"Money is the only wall."** Let a public program pay for your training: [state & federal workforce programs](pages/workforce-programs.md).
- **"I renew a license and need CE hours cheap."** Try [health CEU samplers](pages/health-ceu.md).

## Who this is for

Anyone who needs new job skills and does not currently have tuition money: career changers, returning workers, nurses renewing licenses on tight budgets, small-business owners, and people who read a syllabus for fun. The tone is plain English, step by step, never condescending.

## Not the same site as our other directories

- **free-learn-online-directory** covers the crowd-learner favorites for learning anything online (textbook archives, language apps, coding walks).
- **free-nursing-student-freebies-directory** covers freebies for nursing *students* (flashcards, NCLEX practice, journals).
- **This directory** covers career *upskilling* specifically: audit-mode university courses, employer-readiness certificates, workforce funding, and licensed-professional CEUs.

## Honest notes

- Links and offers were verified by hand on the date shown above. Offers move; the `reports/` folder holds our latest link-check report.
- Health CEU entries are for education and license renewal only. They are never medical advice, and you should confirm credit types with your licensing board before counting contact hours.
- Government program terms (eligibility, amounts, windows) change. The linked official pages are the source of truth.
